title: Module 2 Quiz: Budgeting & Cash Flow Management

questions.text: How should someone with irregular or variable monthly earnings set their baseline spending budget?
options: Based on their highest expected monthly income
Based on their average income over five years
Based on their lowest expected monthly income
Based on total annual projected revenue divided by 52
questions.explanation: To manage irregular income smoothly, you set a baseline budget based on your lowest expected monthly income.

questions.text: If an annual car insurance premium is TT$ 2,400, how much should be set aside monthly in a sinking fund?
questions.explanation: Dividing the annual big expense of TT$ 2,400 by 12 months equals TT$ 200 per month.

questions.text: True or false: A budget should be treated as a living document and reviewed monthly, especially before major events like Carnival or back-to-school.
questions.explanation: The narration states that a budget is a living document that should be reviewed and tweaked monthly as life changes.

questions.text: True or false: When you identify a cash leak, you should immediately reduce that spending category to zero for the following week.
questions.explanation: Rather than cutting spending to zero immediately, the narration advises making minor tweaks (micro-adjustments) so you do not feel restricted or miserable.
